idea-plugin.name: LLM Subscription Usage
idea-plugin.description:
Track and use your LLM subscriptions directly in the IDE.

  • Quota at a glance — usage for OpenAI (ChatGPT/Codex), Claude, SuperGrok/xAI, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, OpenCode Go and Zen (Console browser login), Ollama Cloud, Z.ai, MiniMax, Mistral, Kimi, Azure OpenAI (Azure CLI), and Antigravity (AGY CLI) in the status bar or main toolbar, with a detailed popup showing usage windows and reset times. Multiple logins are supported except for Antigravity, which follows the current CLI account.
  • MCP tools — quota lookup, subscription-backed web search (OpenAI/Codex, SuperGrok/xAI, Mistral, Kimi, Z.ai, MiniMax, Ollama), web fetch (Ollama, Z.ai), image generation (OpenAI/Codex, SuperGrok/xAI Imagine, Mistral, Z.ai GLM-Image, MiniMax) with optional file output, SuperGrok image edits (no masks), video generation (SuperGrok/xAI Imagine, Z.ai CogVideoX), document-to-markdown (Azure Mistral OCR/Document AI, Cohere Parse, or Document Intelligence when selected, Mistral OCR, Z.ai GLM-OCR, OpenAI/Codex, SuperGrok), speech-to-text (OpenAI/Codex, SuperGrok/xAI, Mistral, Z.ai, MiniMax), and text-to-speech (OpenAI/Codex, SuperGrok/xAI, Mistral, MiniMax). Served through IntelliJ's built-in MCP server to the IDE's AI chat and to any external MCP-capable agent. PDF files also offer a right-click conversion action.
  • Local OpenAI-compatible proxy — expose selected subscriptions (OpenAI/Codex, SuperGrok, GitHub Copilot, Kimi, MiniMax, Mistral, Ollama, OpenCode Go and Zen, Z.ai, Azure OpenAI) through standard OpenAI/LiteLLM endpoints, so tools like JetBrains Junie can use them as a custom LLM provider. Optional FIM adapter on /v1/completions for JetBrains AI Completion via the stable model id qwen2.5-coder. Compatibility is tested with the Junie CLI and JetBrains' API Connections for AI features such as the integrated chat.
  • MCP server URL sync — keeps JSON, TOML, and YAML client config files pointed at IntelliJ's active MCP endpoint when its port changes.

Plugin-managed credentials are stored in IntelliJ Password Safe. Antigravity and Azure are CLI exceptions: AGY 1.1.11 or later, and Azure CLI az account get-access-token, using their own logins without importing credential files.
